انتخبن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَخَبْنَ (intaḵabna) /in.ta.xab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# اُنْتُخِبْنَ (untuḵibna) /un.tu.xib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# اِنْتَخِبْنَ (intaḵibna) /in.ta.xib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
